name: Data Scientist
description: Analyses complex data to extract insights and build predictive models.

name: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Designs, trains, and deploys ML models into production systems at scale.

name: Data Engineer
description: Builds and maintains data pipelines, warehouses, and streaming infrastructure.

name: Frontend Developer
description: Builds user interfaces and client-side logic for web applications.

name: Backend Developer
description: Designs and implements server-side APIs, databases, and business logic.

name: Full Stack Developer
description: Handles both frontend and backend concerns across the full web stack.

name: DevOps Engineer
description: Bridges development and operations: CI/CD, containerisation, and infrastructure.

name: Cloud Architect
description: Designs scalable, cost-efficient cloud infrastructure across one or more providers.

name: Software Engineer
description: Designs, writes, tests, and maintains general-purpose software systems.

name: NLP Engineer
description: Specialises in language models, text processing, and conversational AI.

name: Computer Vision Engineer
description: Builds systems that interpret images and video using deep learning.

name: Business Intelligence Analyst
description: Turns data into actionable reports, dashboards, and strategic insights.

name: Site Reliability Engineer
description: Ensures production systems are reliable, scalable, and observable.

name: Mobile Developer
description: Builds cross-platform or native mobile applications for iOS/Android.

name: Security Engineer
description: Designs and implements security controls, reviews code, and runs assessments.
